svg.text: School trip · Fill the gaps with sentences
Last Friday our class went on a trip to the Carpathian Mountains. (1) ______ The
journey took five hours, but nobody was bored because we sang songs and played word
games. When we arrived, our guide, Mr Petrenko, took us to a small wooden hotel. (2)
______ After lunch we went for a long walk to a waterfall. (3) ______ The water was so
cold that we could only stand in it for a minute. In the evening we made a campfire,
and Mr Petrenko told us scary stories. (4) ______ I think it was the best trip of my
A. We left school at six o'clock in the morning.
B. It was a beautiful place, surrounded by tall fir trees.
C. Everybody was very tired, but happy.
D. When we reached it, some of the boys decided to swim.
E. My sister has a new pair of boots.
